Themes & Emotional Palette:
Central themes include personal struggle, resilience, mental health, overcoming adversity, and self-empowerment. The emotional tone oscillates between vulnerability, determination, anger, and hope. Lyrics delve into inner demons, feelings of betrayal, and the desire for redemption, with an underlying current of catharsis and motivational uplift.

Word Choice, Imagery & Motifs:
Sparse yet potent diction, utilizing everyday language infused with intimate confessional imagery. Recurrent motifs include lost girlfriend, real friends, drugs dependency (Powder), heaven and hell symbolism, and illness metaphors. Vocal Style :
Miyagi & Eminem duet style. Both vocal and voice style

[Model: Claude Opus 4.5 | Temperature: 1.41 | Top P: 0.91]

Genre: "dark hip hop, conscious rap, confessional rap, 2000s Detroit" Instruments: "moody piano loop, sparse guitar plucks, hard boom-bap drums, layered harmonies, raw Eminem/Miyagi vocals" Tags: "76 BPM; somber; aggressive-yet-melancholic; minor key; intimate; heavy compression"

[Intro | low spoken vocal | piano loop | vinyl hiss | stripped drums]
Yeah… (nah, don’t sugarcoat it)
If you’re hearing this, guess it’s too late for a rewrite
All that bullshit? Comes back when the sun goes down and I’m stuck inside

[Verse 1 | Eminem lead vocal | desperate tone | melodic inflections | boom-bap groove]
Fuck it, woke up choking, throat’s dry, hope’s fried, missed calls,
Past haunts like old debts, thick air, my room smells like old lies
Checked the date, goddamn, guess we missed another sunrise,
Staring at your Polaroid, why the hell did you stay that night?
Nobody left in my phone who don’t hate me or want a bite
Turned my crew into statues—ain’t none of them real by my side
Mama called again—can’t answer, know I’m the headline she’s tryna fight
Dad’s voice: "get clean"—too late, these lines don't wash right

[Pre-Chorus | layered Miyagi vocal | tight harmonies | subtle strings]
I keep tripping on apologies I never said,
Losing sleep in a stranger’s bed
Punching holes in the past, can’t stitch it up,
Pour one more and tell myself I’m not giving up

[Chorus | Eminem + Miyagi duet | sung-rap hybrid | cracked falsetto | reverb-laden snare]
I keep spinning round these old regrets,
One pill for the pain, one word unsaid
I can’t make peace with all the things I’ve done,
Some demons never run
But I’m tired of waking up just to lose someone

[Verse 2 | Miyagi verse | introspective flow | melodic Russian inflection | backbeat percussion]
She asked, “Was it worth it? Every hit, every high?”
Another day gone, promise that I’d try
Scraping by, watching homies lie in sheets, not sleeping right
Translation: my whole world’s twisting, heart’s heavy but I still write
Words sharper than knives, nights sicker than fights,
Put the powder on the counter—pretending I’ll get right
You said heaven waits for saints, but I ain’t one tonight
Devil on my shoulder, grinning, hungry, taking bites

[Chorus | duet | layered harmonies | dramatic drum fill]
I keep spinning round these old regrets,
One pill for the pain, one word unsaid
I can’t make peace with all the things I’ve done,
Some demons never run
But I’m tired of waking up just to lose someone

[Bridge | Eminem raw vocal | emotional break | piano solo]
All the prayers I never meant, all the hearts I turned away
Chasing some hell, pretending it was grace
Tryna fill a hole I made myself, every memory’s got your face
Drowning in confession, hoping something saves

[Breakdown | Miyagi half-spoken | minimal drums | close mic]
No medals for the broken ones, no trophies for regret,
I stitched myself together, but I ain’t fixed yet
Swallowed every pill, burned every bridge—look at me, ain’t shit left
Maybe that’s why forgiveness feels like another test

[Chorus | full duet | powerful ad-libs | slow crash cymbals]
I keep spinning round these old regrets,
One pill for the pain, one word unsaid
I can’t make peace with all the things I’ve done,
Some demons never run
But I’m tired of waking up just to lose someone

[Outro | whispered vocal | ambient keys | trailing echoes]
Maybe tomorrow I’ll try to forgive the man I’ve become
Or maybe I just learn to live, wishing you hadn’t run

[Verse 1 | storytelling rap flow | somber piano & slow boom bap | double-tracked vocals]  
Wasn’t meant to make it out, I been chasing sleep on a dirty couch  
Mama told me get help, never could pronounce what the fuck’s wrong, duckin' from myself  
Tripped up in prescriptions, powder in the sink—damn  
Numbing pain just a quick fix, blink and I’m pissed, years disappeared, couldn’t plan  
Used to snap at friends just for checkin’ in, told 'em, "leave me the hell alone"  
Truth is, wish I could pick up the phone, rewind all the mess I condoned  
Old Polaroids on the kitchen counter, fake smiles, laughter that don’t sound right  
Girlfriend said, "One more night, you’re gone," so I turned that promise to another fight  
Apologies, overdosed—ain’t enough bandages for damage you never chose  

[Pre-Chorus | desperate melodic rap-sing | strained vocal | tense strings layer]  
God knows, if you saw me now, I wouldn’t beg for you to stick around  
Didn’t mean to turn every hug to a meltdown  
Regret cuts deep, and there’s nobody else left to let down  

[Chorus | raw emotional hook | layered Eminem/Miyagi harmonies | sparse piano + synth pad swell]  
If I could break this skin, peel it back, maybe you’d see what I’ve been holdin' in  
Every scar a name, every shame on replay, wishin' I could start again  
I know I can’t fix what I did, so I live with it (live with it)  
Was a fucked-up kid, still stuck with it (still stuck with it)  
Let me drown in the guilt, let the water run  
If I’m too far gone, then tell me I’m done  

[Verse 2 | aggressive-vulnerable rap | abrupt drum dropouts | pained, confessional delivery]  
Letters in my drawer, never sent ‘cause my hands wouldn’t work  
Can’t blame the drugs forever, gotta own all the hurt  
Fake love in the club, lookin’ for a quick escape, ended up sick, alone with the shame  
Thought fame meant friends, but they left when I went insane  
Paranoia in the bathroom mirror, face I don’t trust lookin’ back, spit  
Used to pray for forgiveness, now I pray that I forget  
Steppin’ over old lines, new scars underneath the ink  
Feelin' thirty years older, haven’t slept in a week  
They said, “Slim, that’s just who you are, cold-hearted, distant, always tryna’ play god”  
But the truth’s I’m scared to let anybody too close, even more scared of the day they’re gone  

[Bridge | quiet rap-sung bridge | filtered vocal, heavy reverb, heartbeat kick]  
Every “sorry” stuck on repeat  
Can’t take back shit, just accept defeat  
Looking up at the ceiling, nothing makes sense  
Would you forgive a man who ain’t innocent?  

[Chorus | heightened emotion | double-time adlibs | building instrumental]  
If I could break this skin, peel it back, maybe you’d see what I’ve been holdin' in  
Every scar a name, every shame on replay, wishin' I could start again  
I know I can’t fix what I did, so I live with it (live with it)  
Was a fucked-up kid, still stuck with it (still stuck with it)  
Let me drown in the guilt, let the water run  
If I’m too far gone, then tell me I’m done  

[Outro | breathless spoken | solo piano | vinyl crackle fx | faint harmonies]  
If I make it out tonight, swear it’s not for me  
It’s for every friend I pushed away, every memory  
No more masks, no more punchlines, no more pretending  
I’m just Marshall—trying to make peace before it’s ending

[Intro | dark piano intro | slow head-nod beat | half-whispered duet delivery | airy vocal layers]
I used to spit at the sky, dared lightning to strike  
Laughing at pills on my nightstand, taunting every vice  
Looked in the fridge for hope, all I found was ice  
Your number’s still on my phone, still can’t press delete twice  
Scraping through texts I sent, words I can’t take back  
These photo booth memories, creased and stuck in a stack  
We’re both scarred, but one of us ain't coming back  

[Verse 1 | Eminem style lead rap | vulnerable confessional flow | dissonant string swells | subtle trap hats]
Guess the punchlines turned into self-defense mechanisms  
Stacked apology letters, never got around to sending them  
Who’d have thought “Slim” could wither, splitting at the edges—  
I made my bed in denial, tossing in regrets, restless  
Used to puff my chest, rage against the ambulance sirens  
Shouted “fuck the world,” couldn’t outrun what’s inside it  
My reflection turned cold, guilt pooling beneath my eyes  
The fights, the nights spent twitching, nobody knew how I tried  
She used to say I’d never change, even if heaven had an entrance  
But if forgiveness is real, damn, where’s my attendance?  
Found my boys gone missing, everybody had their reasons  
Trying to read between apologies and obvious treasons  
How you walk out that door—could you even glance behind?  
Guess we’re all just clinging to reasons, hiding truth behind the rhymes  
Nobody’s perfect—yeah, I tattooed that cliché  
Still chasing comfort I keep pushing away  

[Chorus | Miyagi melodic hook | harmonized duet vocals | pulsing drums | sorrowful piano accents]
Don’t tell me it gets better,  
We both know that’s a line  
Staring at ceiling cracks, searching for a sign  
Would you forgive me if I said I tried?  
Too many nights spent thinking,  
Truth’s tangled in my mind  
All that’s left is this ache I can’t hide

You held me together with half-hearted words,  
Every argument’s a rerun—damn, I know it hurts  
Lines get blurry, innocence, powdered on a tray  
Snorted away sleep, watched real friends drift away  
Every sip just sours the room, used to drown out my panic  
Pretended I was Superman, fell apart, couldn’t stand it  
Mom called from rehab, told me “pray,”—I just hung up  
Swore I’d never beg for help, but pain called my bluff  
Been sick in the head since my teens, tried to mask it  
If there’s a God, guess he’s laughing at all my antics  
Got that scar on my arm, nobody asks how it started  
Just another joke I made, numb when the party departed  
Photos of us laughing—faces stretched too wide  
Played happy, stitched up sadness, let the truth slide  
Had her lipstick on my shirt, apologies in my veins  
Too tired to blame the weather—shit, all I feel now is shame  
All my anthems were armor, just plastic around the wound  
All this sorry I carry, stuck singing the same old tune  

[Chorus | Miyagi melodic hook | harmonized duet vocals | pulsing drums | sorrowful piano accents]
Don’t tell me it gets better,  
We both know that’s a line  
Staring at ceiling cracks, searching for a sign  
Would you forgive me if I said I tried?  
Too many nights spent thinking,  
Truth’s tangled in my mind  
All that’s left is this ache I can’t hide  

[Chorus | repeat | softer harmony build | light strings | stripped percussion]
Don’t tell me it gets better,  
We both know that’s a line  
Staring at ceiling cracks, searching for a sign  
Would you forgive me if I said I tried?  
Too many nights spent thinking,  
Truth’s tangled in my mind  
All that’s left is this ache I can’t hide  

[Outro | muted piano | sparse beat | whispered duet lines | intimate delivery]
I wrote these words for you  
Hoping one will make it through  
If regret was a payment, I’m already overdue  
The person I was—guess he never had a clue  
Tell ‘em Slim Shady tried, at least once, to tell the truth

Yeah, I'm sittin' here, it's three in the mornin', thinkin' back on what I ruined

Days slip like medicine drippin’ out, cold sweat, layin' on the hardwood

Heaven ain’t for me, not with all these habits I’ve been flauntin’  
Hidin' from the sunrise, bags under red eyes, shiverin' in the winter  
Lookin' for my name in a crowd but they forget you when you splinter  
She was real, man, more than a ring, more than a quick fuck  
Now she got another life, I hope he loves her better, wish I could wish luck  
Pop another pill for the courage, dial her number, never press send  
Tellin' myself I'm different, but the cycle just spins again  
All this therapy money, all these interviews and shows  
Doesn’t matter, fame don’t fix the ache that everybody knows  
Real ones disappear, fake ones pull up, toast to your misery  
Bottle’s just a trophy for a war nobody’s winning, see?  
Tryna fix the kid inside, still makes messes on the carpet  
Tears on my hoodie, yeah, nobody else’s target  
Father to a stranger, son to a question mark  
Try to be a man, but it’s harder when the world’s so sharp

Sorry ain’t enough, but I had to say it, so here it is

Sorry that I let myself get so far out  
Can’t go back, can’t clean the mess I made

Another page in the book, another truth I can’t hide  
Lights go out, and I hope you’re alright
